title: Read multi-step transition probabilities
description: You extract a conditional probability and advance an initial distribution.
source: draft: codex free model + edit: codex

steps.description: You compute the three-step transition matrix and print it. P3 stores probabilities for moving between states across three transitions.

steps.question: Which recorded value gives Sunny to Rainy in three steps?
steps.answer: P3[0,2] gives 0.222, following the state interpretation in the comment.

steps.description: You print that entry as the probability of Rainy at t+3 given Sunny at t. It describes the endpoint state after three transitions.
You advance pi0 by 15 transitions and print the resulting distribution.
